added_items.item: Monitor rss and external as well as heapUsed; if rss grows but heapUsed is flat, the leak is outside the JS heap (Buffers, native addons, unclosed streams)
pm2 `--max-memory-restart 1500M` command and systemd restart as options for automatic restart
`node --heapsnapshot-near-heap-limit=3` writes snapshots automatically just before the crash
Take a third snapshot and compare via the Comparison view, sorting by size delta
Specific commands: `kill -USR2 <pid>` to trigger snapshot, loading via Load in DevTools Memory tab
clinic heapprofiler for finding allocating code paths
DevTools allocation timeline / live heap profiling via --inspect
Connection pools or streams never closed as a cause
Request or session data stored in module-level variables as a cause
Do snapshots on staging or one instance (staging option)
Distinguishes leak types using rss and external in process.memoryUsage(): if rss grows but heapUsed is flat, leak is off-heap (Buffers, native addons, unclosed streams)
If memory is stable but near the limit, raising the limit is the right fix
pm2 --max-memory-restart 1500M as a concrete restart-before-crash command
--heapsnapshot-near-heap-limit=3 writes snapshots automatically just before crash, a good option for capturing the failure
Take three snapshots and use Comparison view sorted by size delta; includes the exact kill -USR2 <pid> step
Extra causes: request/session data in module-level variables, connection pools or streams never closed
